question: 栖霞区有多少家星巴克（按品牌标签）？

question: 从云南路地铁站步行到鼓楼地铁站，最短步行距离是多少米？
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT ST_NearestVertex AS v FROM (SELECT (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> (SELECT geom FROM metro_stations WHERE name = '云南路' LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1) AS ST_NearestVertex) t), b AS (SELECT (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> (SELECT geom FROM metro_stations WHERE name = '鼓楼' LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1) AS v) SELECT agg_cost AS distance_m FROM pgr_dijkstra('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', (SELECT v FROM a), (SELECT v FROM b), directed := false) ORDER BY agg_cost DESC LIMIT 1;

final_sql: WITH a AS (SELECT ST_NearestVertex AS v FROM (SELECT (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> (SELECT geom FROM metro_stations WHERE name = '云南路' LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1) AS ST_NearestVertex) t), b AS (SELECT (SELECT id FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> (SELECT geom FROM metro_stations WHERE name = '鼓楼' LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1) AS v) SELECT agg_cost AS distance_m FROM pgr_dijkstra('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', (SELECT v FROM a), (SELECT v FROM b), directed := false) ORDER BY agg_cost DESC LIMIT 1

question: 按 GB 50180-2018 对初中服务半径的要求，诚品城小区沿步行路网是否有中学？
sql: WITH ra AS (SELECT id, name, ST_PointOnSurface(geom) AS pt FROM residential_areas WHERE name LIKE '%诚品城%' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), v AS (SELECT wv.id FROM walk_vertices wv, ra WHERE wv.in_main = true ORDER BY wv.geom <-> ra.pt LIMIT 1), c AS (SELECT clause_id, max_radius_m FROM standard_clauses WHERE facility LIKE '%中学%' AND max_radius_m IS NOT NULL ORDER BY max_radius_m LIMIT 1), reach AS (SELECT dd.node FROM v, c, pgr_drivingDistance('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', v.id, c.max_radius_m, directed := false) dd) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pois p JOIN reach r ON true WHERE p.category = 'amenity' AND p.subtype = 'school' AND p.name LIKE '%中学%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM walk_vertices wv WHERE wv.in_main = true AND wv.id = r.node AND ST_DWithin(wv.geom::geography, p.geom::geography, 0))) AS compliant, c.clause_id, c.max_radius_m AS radius_m FROM c;

question: 按国标公交车站服务半径，青秀城小区是否被公交站覆盖（沿步行路网）？
sql: WITH ra AS (SELECT geom FROM residential_areas WHERE name LIKE '%青秀城%' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), start AS (SELECT v.id FROM walk_vertices v, ra WHERE v.in_main = true ORDER BY v.geom <-> ST_PointOnSurface(ra.geom) LIMIT 1), clause AS (SELECT clause_id, max_radius_m FROM standard_clauses WHERE facility LIKE '%公交%' AND max_radius_m IS NOT NULL ORDER BY max_radius_m LIMIT 1), reach AS (SELECT dd.node FROM start s, clause c, pgr_drivingDistance('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', s.id, c.max_radius_m, directed := false) dd) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bus_stops b, reach r, start s WHERE (SELECT v.id FROM walk_vertices v WHERE v.in_main = true ORDER BY v.geom <-> b.geom LIMIT 1) = r.node) AS compliant, (SELECT clause_id FROM clause) AS clause_id, (SELECT max_radius_m FROM clause) AS radius_m;

question: 南湾营泰康苑小区步行 5 分钟（4.8 km/h）内有几个公交站点（站点记录）？
